plugin.name: eForm Craft
plugin.description: Upload a paper form as image, PDF, Excel or Word and get it rebuilt into an interactive e-form (schema + HTML preview + mock data), verified field by field and revisable via natural language.
agent.eform.name: Form Crafter
agent.eform.description: Entry point for paper-form digitalization: reads layout and field markers, rebuilds an interactive form with demo data, and guards the field-level confirmation gate.
